# Setup

Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(irr)
library(irrNA)

```

## Import data and wrangle

### Annoyance data

```{r}

annoyDatapath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest2_AnnoyDataBySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest2_AnnoyDataBySubjWide.csv", "refmap_listest2_AnnoyDataBySubjWide.csv"), ncol=2))

annoyData <- read.csv(annoyDatapath, header=TRUE)

# transpose the data
annoyData <- setNames(data.frame(t(annoyData[,-1])), annoyData[,1])
# keep only the 110 stimuli rows
annoyData <- annoyData[1:110,]
# convert to numeric
annoyData <- dplyr::mutate_all(annoyData, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

```

### Pleasantness data

```{r}
pleasantDatapath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest2_PleasantDataBySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
```

### Eventfulness data

```{r}

eventfulDatapath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest2_EventfulDataBySubjWide.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment 2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
```

## Calculate ICC

```{r}

irrNA::iccNA(annoyData)

irrNA::iccNA(pleasantData)

irrNA::iccNA(eventfulData)


```
